title: Bespoke car finance on PistonHeads
content:
Specialising in classic, prestige and supercar finance, Charles & Dean offer some of the most competitive and bespoke solutions on the market, allowing our customers to get behind the wheel of their dream car.
Our unrivalled passion for the industry combined with our in-depth market knowledge, ensures we can tailor long or short term agreements with realistic deposits and balloon structures to suit the needs and requirements of each client.
Charles & Dean support our customers' driving ambitions through bespoke funding options and unique deal structures. Through our exceptional customer service and friendly and professional approach, we focus on the individual circumstances of each customer to ensure a transparent, tailored and competitive service.
"PistonHeads is delighted to be working with Charles & Dean. It is great to collaborate with a company that is so passionate about changing the face of the industry by challenging the norm and doing things differently. We hope that Charles & Dean's personal yet professional approach to customer service enables PHers to enjoy a refreshingly straightforward way to finance their next dream car," said Sam Liggett, Head of Partnerships for PistonHeads.
